responsibility: This file contains a broad set of NDS32 backend helper routines used by RTL expanders and asm output templates in the machine descriptions. Its responsibilities include branch-template construction, constant and TLS/PIC address expansion, doubleword splitting, load/store and stack-operation formatting, symbolic and relaxation-aware asm emission, and assorted low-level helpers for interpreting operands, making it the central support library that many .md patterns call into during expansion and final output.
